title: Bitrate Attributes
description: Attributes encoding the bit-rate of a rendition.

adaptive.description: Whether the rendition media has a fixed bitrate or is available using ABR (Adaptive Bitrate Streaming)

maxBitrate.description: In the case of ABR, the maximum bitrate of the rendition in bits per second.

minBitrate.description: In the case of ABR, the minimum bitrate of the rendition in bits per second.

adaptive.description: Whether the rendition media has a fixed bitrate or is available using ABR (Adaptive Bitrate Streaming)

bitrate.description: In the case of fixed bitrate, the bitrate of the rendition in bits per second.
